hints.title: Count Primes within Range
hints.text: Count how many integers between 1 and n are prime.

hints.title: Independent Permutation Subsets
hints.text: Primes must occupy the prime index slots (factorial of p ways), and composite or unit numbers must occupy the remaining slots (factorial of (n - p) ways).

hints.title: Factorial Multiplication Modulo 10^9 + 7
hints.text: Compute the product of factorial(p) and factorial(n - p) modulo 1000000007 using modular arithmetic at each multiplication step.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Generating full permutations of size N takes O(N!) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Counting primes and computing factorials takes linear time and constant auxiliary memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize that 1 is not a prime and perform factorial calculations modulo 10^9 + 7.
